name: cicy-agent
title: Cicy Agent
description: Operate tmux panes and windows on this host. Wraps cicy-code's /api/tmux/* endpoints (list, capture, send-keys, msg, create, restart, clear).
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Cicy Agent (tmux)
zh-CN.description: 通过 cicy-code /api/tmux/* 端点操作 tmux 面板和窗口（列表、capture、send-keys、msg、create、restart、clear），支持多节点。

tools.name: tmux list
tools.description: List all tmux panes and windows

tools.name: tmux send
tools.description: Send keys to a tmux pane

tools.name: tmux msg
tools.description: Send a message to an agent worker

tools.name: broadcast
tools.description: Group-send a message to ONLINE agents only (offline cannot receive; no --all). Per-send timeout so dead panes cannot stall; prints delivered/failed stats; skips the sender.

tools.name: agents online/offline/all
tools.description: Roster by liveness: get_online/offline/all_agents. Rows: id, title, duty, agent_type, online, model, provider, local_gateway, context_usage, cost, idle. Runtime fields show n/a when unavailable.
